description: Small Restaurant and wine bar, 40-60 seat. - Lunch and dinner.
Develop new menu every month based on season and availability of products, Also provide 2-5 specials every night.
Developed small bar menu, set up Kitchen equipment and flow, hired and trained all BOH staff, operate large private events.
Work with owner of labor and food cost.
100+ seat restaurant with large lounge area, catering for events of 500+ people.

Responsible for all food production, staffing, training, hiring, terminating, organization, purchasing for the Kitchen. Reported weekly Inventory and tracked purchase, Sales, and labor on a weekly basis.
Five star luxury Hotel with restaurants Stonehouse & Plow and angel. Create seasonal menus, daily soups and specials.
Instructed FOH in daily meetings about menu changes and specials, trained and managed BOH daily in every position and job.
Instructed 1st and 2nd period classes at local high school. Teaching basic knowledge, safety and entering the hospitality job market.
Managed and operated two popular restaurants/Bars. Staffed, trained and organized two full service kitchens while creating and costing the menu.
Working directly with Executive Chef and Owner creating seasonal, local, farmers market oriented cuisine with an emphasis on "In House" made.
Created the menu for a small wine oriented bistro. Trained and hired staff to execute new menu, keep organized and clean.

Responsible for managing food production, catering small and large events (500+ attendees), overseeing a team of 10+ employees, serving as onsite chef, creating, preparing, and plating meals; cleaning and ordering products. Evaluated and trained new employees.
Introduced weekly specials and menu items for 30-seat French fine dining/. catering restaurant. Prepared and plated hot line dishes, salads and desserts.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust and diverse career trajectory in the culinary industry, spanning various roles from line cook to executive chef. With over a decade of experience managing high-volume restaurants, luxury hotels, and large-event catering, the candidate demonstrates exceptional skills in kitchen management, menu development, staff training, and customer relations. The ability to adapt menus based on seasonal availability highlights a pragmatic approach to food production, which is complemented by handling inventory control and managing teams across multiple kitchens. With an educational background in culinary management from the Art Institute of California, the candidate's theoretical knowledge is well-grounded in practical experience within the industry.
